summary: Run profiles must never apply or store --execute or --allow-unknown-tool; a credit spend is confirmed only on the current command line.
reason: ApplyProfileToFlags overlaid any saved flag, so a profile with execute=true turned a free preview into a paid Pin Generator call without the user typing --execute.
validated_outcome: TestSavedProfileCannotArmSpend (zero paid calls; explicit --execute still spends once) and TestProfileApplyNeverSuppliesSpendConfirmations.
